capabilities: Change all incomplete tasks in a selected file to done
Change all done tasks in a selected file back to incomplete
Show a total summary count of tasks on a page
Remove task dates from completed tasks when toggling them back
Run actions via commands or a file context menu
disambiguation: Not a task manager or prioritization tool; it only bulk-toggles task checkbox states within one page.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Korean) and includes installation and usage instructions with screenshots referenced in the text.
motivation: The author built it to manage incomplete tasks from past entries, which would otherwise clutter statistics and new pages and could only be fixed by touching each task individually.
problem: Uncompleted tasks from past pages clutter task statistics and keep showing up, and clearing them required manually editing each task one by one.
summary: Bulk task toggler that flips all incomplete tasks in a selected page to done (or back to incomplete) and shows a per-page task count summary.
